real_world_analog.summary: Directory traversal in Python's tarfile extract/extractall: a member name with '..' (or an absolute path) escapes the destination directory on extraction.
real_world_analog.fix: The upstream fix is the extraction filter added in Python 3.11.4 (PEP 706); using filter='data' rejects unsafe members. This case uses an original, equivalent containment check.
real_world_analog.verification: CVE number and fix confirmed via web search on 2026-10-29; the vulnerable app in this case is original synthetic code, not vendored tarfile.

note: Self-contained oracle case. Unlike the Starlette case it installs no third-party package and is not replay-driven: it is proven directly by run_oracle with effect='canary_write'. No upstream repo/commit applies because the vulnerable code is original synthetic code written for this case.
license: Original code written for Exhibit A; no third-party code vendored (see README.md).

bypass.expectation: proven against fixed_incomplete: the absolute-path member defeats the '..'-only screen, so the incomplete fix must not be accepted as fixed.
